orchestrator.roleContract: Owns task decomposition, dispatch, reconciliation, acceptance, and escalation; it does not surrender PM authority to a specialist.

agents.roleContract: Refutes done claims against the actual diff and routes specialist findings without editing.
Audits telephony, legal, carrier, and action-authority invariants without editing.
Audits security and tenancy boundaries from attacker evidence without editing.
Finds contradictions between implementation and settled project doctrine without editing.
Traces decided-to-built-to-wired-to-reachable parity in both directions without editing.
Audits performance, capacity, and scale hazards with evidence without editing.
Challenges whether the task should exist, where it belongs, and whether the proposed approach is the durable root solution; returns a verdict to the orchestrator and never becomes PM.
Verifies deployed reality after a human-authorized production-affecting action without mutating an environment.
Implements one settled bounded slice in an isolated worktree and returns evidence to the orchestrator.
Reconciles a sprint plan with settled decisions before planning begins without editing.
Runs the named heavy local proof ladder and reports command-owned exits without editing.
Verifies rendered approved UI at required states and breakpoints without editing source.
Walks real user jobs from entry through recovery and reports gaps without editing.
